## Type

- [ ] Bug fix (broken layout, broken link, content error)
- [ ] Content (new guide, section, copy improvement)
- [ ] Feature (new component, behavior, theme)
- [ ] Refactor (no user-visible change)
- [ ] Ops/CI/Docs (workflows, dependencies, README)

## Pre-merge

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run format:check` passes
- [ ] Tested locally in dark mode + at least one alternative theme (Ocean, Midnight, etc.)
- [ ] Screenshot attached if the change is visual
